_doc: STATIC-CONTENT-1 for every system (Rowan, 2026-11-25: "Static content is NOT autonomous and is contrary to the objective of an Ultrastable system."). Read by scripts/staticcontent.py. `urls` are the public pages the system serves (the boot fills the first from the deployed Worker url); a page whose visible text has not changed in `max_unchanged_days` is a finding, and the fix is to bind the page to a loop (a generated block, a feed, a live read), never to touch the text. A page meant to stay fixed is exempt with a reason.
